items.title: 67426_Hayes Pillars oral history interview
items.q: And we opened the show with Ziggy Johnson producing the shows.

ctx.x: After Whitman. That was '37. He joined our band, but he joined at the Plantation, not the Summit. He joined us at the Plantation, Porter did. And we opened the show with Ziggy Johnson producing the shows. And brought a line of chorus girls Ziggy (unintelligible) out of Chicago, down to St. Louis. And Ziggy had some fresh ideas for the show. And he used to dress The girls nice. We always had beautiful costumes.
So the band and Ziggy got along nicely. We had to teach Ziggy how to start a band off, and finally he learned how to do it, and then he -- he was a great director, wasn't he?
